claims: 10 of 11 pure-Python backends produce byte-for-byte identical canonical digests across CPython 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14, and 3.14t; the single 1-byte split on chrome_trace:torch-trace between 3.10/3.11 and 3.12+ comes from PEP 659 / CPython 3.12 Neumaier float summation in sum().
All 11 fixture reader parse latencies are sub-2ms across all six interpreters on amd-ryzen-ai-9-hx-370-x64 (cache bypassed, N=50 after 5 warmups).

Free-threaded CPython 3.14t preserves digest hash correctness under 8-thread contention on report_store.cache.cached_units and achieves 2.36x same-path and 2.90x mixed-path throughput vs the 3.14 GIL build on this host.
limits: Single host (ASUS TUF A14, AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370), single sequential pass; reader microbenchmarks do not generalize across hosts or to large captures.
Raw interpreter_matrix_raw artifacts did not record process RSS or cgroup memory.peak, so every cell sets memoryCoverage to 'none' rather than fabricating memory numbers.
Raw latency JSON recorded order statistics {median_us, q1_us, q3_us, iqr_us, n}; wall.min/max are populated from [q1_us, q3_us] and wall.stdev from iqr_us.
3.14t cache contention measures library-level report_store.cache.cached_units locking, not live FastMCP server concurrency.
